Francisco, a fantastic professional, took care of him. He was attentive and friendly. From the first moment, he knew exactly how we wanted the cut and made him look absolutely gorgeous.

Thank you so much for everything!

It's wonderful to hear you enjoyed your experience at Kiwoko, Pedro. We truly appreciate your positive feedback, and it inspires us to continue offering the best for you and your pets. We look forward to seeing you again soon for anything you need.
Super friendly and helpful service, plus fast attention. I'll definitely be back.
It's a real pleasure to hear you had such a positive experience, Pedro. We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. We're here for you and your pets whenever you need us.
It's wonderful to receive your feedback, L. We deeply appreciate the time you took to rate us. We hope to continue being your top choice for the care of your furry friends.

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review of Zouhair. We sincerely appreciate every gesture of recognition and kindness from our customers. We remain committed to providing the best for you and the animals we care so deeply for.

Ladislao, we sincerely regret that your experience with us was not satisfactory. We greatly value every opinion, as it helps us improve every day. We hope that in the future you will change your mind and that we can serve you as you deserve.

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review as yours, Julieta. We want to thank you for taking the time to share your experience and give us the highest rating. Your words are the best encouragement we have to continue offering the best for you and your pets.
The staff were super nice and the shop was very tidy and well-organized.
Mercedes, it's a pleasure to receive such a positive review. We greatly appreciate you sharing your experience with us. Warm regards from the entire Kiwoko team.
Excellent service and fast home delivery
Facundo, we sincerely appreciate you taking a moment to share your experience at Kiwoko. It's a pleasure to know your visit was positive. We hope to see you again soon at our store.

It's a real pleasure to receive such positive feedback as yours, Enrique. We sincerely appreciate you taking a moment to rate your experience with us. We hope to continue being your top choice for all your pet care needs.
They always treat me great.

I want to report the mistreatment my 2-year-old dog suffered at the hands of Jesús, the groomer at that shop.

She's a short-haired white dog, and I took her in for a bath and brushing. They used a metal-toothed rake on her, which left wounds all over her back and neck, with holes and blood. She had a fever of 40 degrees Celsius for three days. I thought she was going to die because it happened on the weekend, and I couldn't take her to the vet until Monday. They had to give her three injections.
I don't want anyone else to suffer the kind of mistreatment my dog ​​endured.
I spent over 100 euros on the vet, plus the 52 euros that groomer charged me, and I'm still waiting for a solution.
It's 9:22 PM and they close at 9:30 PM and they tell me I can't come in
Thank you so much for your feedback, Lina. It's a real pleasure to know that your experience earned you a perfect rating. We're always here for anything you need for your pets' well-being.

I bought a toy set for my Pomeranian puppy (under 1 kg) at Kiwoko Bravo Murillo. The first plush toy broke on the first use. Since we're on vacation outside of Madrid, I didn't give him the rest of the toys until yesterday. When I gave him one of the chew toys for the first time, it also broke within a few hours, and my dog ​​swallowed a piece. Fortunately, he was able to spit it out, but it could have had much more serious consequences.

I immediately contacted the store to report the problem and request a solution. I explained that I'll be out of Madrid until August 14th and, for that reason, I can't go in before the 13th or show them the rest of the toys yet. As soon as I return, I'll provide all the photos and evidence. Even so, the only response from the employee, based on "her supervisor's orders," was that I had to come in person before the 13th, without offering any alternative.

What worries me most is not just the quality of the product, but the lack of concern regarding a potential safety risk for a pet. I will submit the corresponding official complaint form and I trust that Kiwoko will review both this product and the management carried out by this store.
Great store, I love it!

My mother took her dog to the groomer (I've included the receipt with the date, address, and the name of the person who attended to them). The damage they caused to the dog is unacceptable. (Google Reviews won't let me upload photos of the dog's condition).
Days later, they had to take her to the vet because she developed a fever (39.8°C), refused to eat, and was generally unwell due to the mistreatment she suffered at the groomer's.
She had holes in her skin from the comb they used, which became infected.
I've also attached photos from the vet and photos of how the dog is currently doing.
Kiwoko hasn't even apologized... it's a disgraceful place. Don't take your pets to this groomer.
I took my rabbit in for a haircut and dry bath and they treated her wonderfully, very professional in their work, thank you very much!
They have plenty of things for dogs and cats, but less for other small animals. The staff are very friendly.

Thank you so much for taking the time to rate us, Raf. It's wonderful to know that our stores meet your expectations. We hope to continue being your trusted place for all things animal-related. See you soon!
Excellent service, 10/10

Jesus is a wonderful groomer! He let me watch him wash and groom my little one, and he looks adorable!! Highly recommended for his patience and love for animals, as well as his style and professionalism. 10/10.

What a pleasure to see such a positive review of our store. It's a true honor to have customers like you who recognize our efforts. We greatly appreciate the time you've taken to share your experience.
Every time I stop by the store it's a pleasure, they always help me, they are very kind and charming.
Kai, my Bichon Frise, got his hair cut today and he looks fantastic! I'll be back. Thank you!
Very friendly and a great variety of products, plus they give you great guidance when choosing.
Very attentive and friendly staff!
They've always been reliable and efficient. I can find the reptile food I need here.
It's a pleasure to shop at this store; they always have a wide variety of products and brands, and the staff makes it even better. Thank you, Patricia!
You can find almost everything for your furry friend, and if not, you can order it online and pick it up in store or have it delivered to your home.
100% recommended for the treatment and advice given to people who have pets
Always wonderful service!
They always guide me and help me with any doubts, especially if you're a first-timer with a kitten, and they are also very kind.
Always great, excellent advisors
Excellent service from Yoreida, very friendly, and excellent prices.

I love this place because it welcomes my little one as if it were her own home, and my baby is always welcome here. I'll always come back. Inés and all the staff who help me are always so kind.
Best regards

It's wonderful to receive your feedback, Vladimir. Your support is invaluable to us and encourages us to continue working with enthusiasm for the well-being of all animals. We hope to continue offering you the best experience at Kiwoko.

Excellent customer service, and Inés provided very helpful advice (thank you so much!). She was very kind and professional; I had some questions about a cat food I'd bought, and she answered all my questions and gave me some great recommendations.
The store has a great selection, and the staff are generally very friendly.
Jesus was a sweetheart. My dog ​​Tokyo looked gorgeous! He gave her a fantastic haircut.

Great experience! I made a mistake with my order, but the guy who helped me was very kind and sorted everything out himself. I only had to wait a few minutes and took advantage of the great deals they have. Many thanks to this Kiwoko employee!

Miguel, taking the time to leave such a positive review means a lot to us. It's a pleasure to know you had a satisfying experience in our store. We're always here to offer the best for you and your beloved pets.
very nice staffs. kudos!
Always excellent service.
Fantastic hairdressing service. Jesus is a star!
I always go to this store. The service from Lea and all her colleagues is excellent.
Very good store
Very kind and caring with the animals. We love the grooming service Jesús offers; he treats them wonderfully and is very patient. They should give him a raise!! Hahaha

It's fantastic to receive such positive feedback as yours, Andreé. We're so glad to hear that your experience was exceptional. We'll continue working every day to maintain the trust you place in us. Thank you for choosing us!

I went to the store to buy some supplies and ran into Jesús, who was super friendly and gave us an impromptu mini-lesson on how to properly brush my Toy Poodle! He was so nice and said my Simba looked like a fried chicken, and he was right! 🐕 I'm so lucky to have him give my little furry friend his first bath and haircut. 🐾 …
The service is always spectacular.
I really like this store, they have everything and there are always deals.
Excellent service both by phone and in person, the staff were incredibly friendly. Thank you so much!
I've been there several times because the staff is so friendly. Yesterday they helped me find a harness for my dog. They tried it on her with great patience and affection.
Everything was delicious and the service was excellent, we'll definitely be back.
It's a real pleasure to receive your rating, Luis Manuel. Every comment counts for us and helps us continue offering the best to our customers. We hope to see you soon at Kiwoko, Mundo Animal.
The staff at the store are always amazing, it's a pleasure to shop there.
The guys always treat me really well, hehehe
This morning I went to the store and, apart from solving my problem very quickly, it's a pleasure dealing with the staff at the Bravo Murillo store. I highly recommend it.
I always shop here, the saleswomen are always friendly 😼 …
The shop assistants are always very friendly.
I really liked the way the employees treated me, offering me a very good deal.

I want to thank Sara for her attention. She was very kind, polite, and attentive throughout the entire visit. She helped me with a great attitude, answering my questions clearly and showing a real interest in providing the best service. A very positive experience thanks to her.

The sales assistants were incredibly rude, ill-mannered, and arrogant. I had to file a complaint this afternoon, and I definitely won't be back! Besides, the tiny shop in Sanse or Vaguada is far superior in every way.

Sara provided excellent service. She exudes confidence, professionalism, and a deep understanding of her work. She answered all my questions with kindness and efficiency, making the experience very positive. It's a pleasure to find people so dedicated and attentive to their customers.

I want to highlight Sara's excellent service. She was very kind, attentive, and friendly at all times, professionally answering my questions and making me feel very well taken care of. Her service was impeccable, and she inspired confidence and dedication. Thank you so much for the great service!

I've been ordering through the app and shopping there for years.
They have everything for all kinds of animals.
I love it! Online orders arrive at the store very quickly, and you can pick them up there at your leisure.

I want to especially acknowledge the excellent work of Jesús, the dog groomer at Kiwoko Bravo Murillo. We've been taking our dog Dany to this groomer for about four years now, but before, he used to come out quite stressed, mainly because he doesn't like being locked in the kennel after his haircut.

Since Jesús started working there, the experience has completely changed. He not only gives Dany a fantastic haircut, always offering great advice based on what's best for him, but he also treats him with a very personalized and careful touch. You can tell he dedicates time, patience, and affection to him, preventing him from getting stressed afterward.

We are very grateful for his professionalism and the special care he gives Dany. Without a doubt, he's a great professional and highly recommended.
Very kind

Excellent experience! Great service and great products. I always buy everything my dog ​​needs.

Excellent work by Jesús, very kind and an expert as a dog stylist 👏🏻👏🏻 …

I regularly buy my dog's food here. The staff are very friendly, and when I go with Yoko, they treat her wonderfully. They're always willing to help with anything you ask. Plus, the store is clean and tidy.

What a thoughtful gesture, Maria, to take a moment to leave us such a positive review. The entire Kiwoko team sincerely thanks you for your support. We hope to continue being your trusted store whenever you need us.
☺️Very large, clean and quiet place, Inés is very friendly ☺️

The care was always excellent for my baby.
Friendly and helpful sales staff. They collaborate with animal shelters. Good deals.

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review from you, Erika. We're here to make sure you and your pets find what you need. We sincerely thank you for taking a moment to share your experience with us.

It's a pleasure to receive your feedback, Adolfo. We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to leave such a positive review. We hope to continue earning your trust and providing you and your pets with the best possible service.

Cristina, receiving feedback like yours truly motivates us every day. We greatly appreciate your trust in Kiwoko and that you chose to share your positive experience. We hope to continue offering you and your pet the very best.

The first thing that hit me: I asked for an internal antiparasitic, which I'd already seen they had at the entrance of the store, but I asked for it anyway, and the girl (completely clueless) [and then they ask for 2000 animal knowledge requirements to work in a place like this] tells me that's only available at veterinary clinics... you're left dumbfounded thinking: then explain to me why you have it for sale?? But I thought, okay... I'll let it slide. She calmly spends 10 minutes trying to get the dewormer in, and her colleague, who actually told me they had internal dewormer and did sell it, is the one who finally gets it for me. But seeing that his colleague is taking a long time to get the product in and there are people waiting in line, instead of helping her, explaining, or showing her how, he moves on to the other customers while I keep waiting for her to sort it out on her own... (very rude of a colleague/manager or boss). And when she goes to charge me: €150! I'm stunned. When I ask her, "Wait, how much does each thing cost?!" she corrects herself once, "Oh, now it's €114," and I tell her how much each item costs. When she breaks it down, you can see she realizes another mistake and corrects it. In the end, it's €109... I think the difference is significant! But hey, if you leave and you've overpaid, well, that's what they get for it, right? If you're training someone, make sure you teach them, but also support your own team, because I'm never coming back.
Besides the fact that I almost paid over €40, the staff treated me with complete ignorance about the products and the protocols, and the lack of teamwork... it was truly pathetic.
I went to return some cat litter and they helped me choose a better one. And they refunded my money. They treated me very well and solved the problem.
The employee who served me knew the products she sells well and was also very pleasant, quick and efficient.

The best store with great discounts!

Very kind

I understand that people without proof might be able to get it, but someone who can show it... I'm very disappointed.

Warning!!!! DO NOT TAKE YOUR DOG TO THIS GROOMER. I took my 8-month-old puppy, Brownie, there for a bath. When we came out, his eyes were bothering him, and we ended up at the emergency vet hours later because he couldn't open them. The result: he had burns and ulcers in both eyes, as you can see in the photo. The emergency vet couldn't believe it, because it's one thing to accidentally spill some product (which he should have warned me about), but it's another thing entirely to have both eyes burned like that. And let's not even talk about the financial cost—more than 480 euros for the emergency room visit, antibiotics, and more than six follow-up appointments—they almost blinded my 8-month-old puppy! It's a matter of neglect and having zero responsibility for our pets. I think this groomer should never be allowed to touch a dog again. It took me a while to write this review because I'm still feeling unwell and didn't feel like it, but out of responsibility to other dogs, I had to. I have nothing but praise for the shop; they've always treated us wonderfully.

Today, Horus, a Pomeranian, was able to get a bath and a haircut with scissors. It sounds simple and commonplace, but because he was a gift dog and had previously been mistreated, it was risky for the professionals, to the point that medication was necessary. I admired Jesús's professionalism. Today, Horus left happy and handsome. And I'm delighted to have found a place like this for Horus.

100% recommended.
Thank you, Jesús.
